meta_title: Enviro Heating & Plumbing | Gas Engineer Bolton
meta_description: Enviro Heating and Plumbing Services in Bolton. 20+ years' experience. Gas Safe registered. Emergency boiler repairs, installations, and heating services. Call now.
hero_subhead: Broken boiler? Our gas engineers arrive fast and fix most faults the same day, keeping your home warm and your bills fair.
services_heading: Complete Heating and Plumbing Services Across Bolton
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to new system installations, we handle every aspect of your heating and plumbing needs.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Boiler broken down? We diagnose and fix most faults on the spot, with parts carried on the van. No job too urgent — we're available 24/7.

services.title: Boiler Installation and Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted quickly and installed to Building Regulations. We help you choose the right system for your home and budget, with a 10-year warranty on most installations.

services.title: Central Heating Service and Maintenance
services.desc: Annual boiler servicing and heating system checks keep your system running efficiently and safely. Catch problems before they cost you money.

services.title: Radiator Repairs and Installation
services.desc: Leaking radiator or cold spots? We repair, bleed, and install new radiators. Balanced heating means lower energy bills and a warmer home.

services.title: Pipe and Leak Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes and water leaks fixed fast to prevent damage. We locate the problem quickly and repair it properly, from small drips to major breaks.

services.title: Power Flushing and System Cleaning
services.desc: Over time, sludge builds up in heating systems and slows them down. Power flushing clears blockages and improves heating efficiency significantly.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of seeing people ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: Enviro Heating and Plumbing Services was founded on a simple idea: do honest work at fair prices. With over 20 years in the heating and plumbing trade, we've built a reputation across Bolton for turning up on time, fixing things right, and being straight with our customers about what they need and what they don't.
about_para_2: We're Gas Safe registered and fully insured. Every job comes with a clear quote upfront — no surprises when the invoice arrives. Repeat customers make up the bulk of our work, which tells you we do what we promise.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with our boiler in December — wouldn't fire up and it was freezing. Called Enviro and they came out within the hour. Turned out to be a failed pump, but the engineer explained everything as he went along. Fixed it properly and charged a fair price. Top marks.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Replaced our old boiler last spring. The team were tidy, efficient, and the new system is brilliant — heating bills have dropped noticeably. They sorted out a couple of dodgy radiators at the same time without faffing about. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer K.

reviews.text: Leak from upstairs radiator was running down the wall. Rang on a Saturday afternoon, they answered straight away, and came round the same day. No fuss, no drama, just fixed it. These lads are exactly what you want — reliable, honest, and they know their stuff.
reviews.author: David P.
